summary: E-SPAK iteration 3 verified end-to-end. Backend pytest (test_iter3_features.py) 5/5 PASSED covering: (a) tipe_pegawai seed distribution — pegawai1..10 = exactly 3 ASN (pegawai3, pegawai6, pegawai9) + 7 BLUD as specified; (b) create user with tipe_pegawai=ASN persists (is_blud auto-derived false), update to BLUD persists (is_blud auto true); (c) leave attachment: upload PNG while status=diajukan ok, GET /leaves/{id}/attachment returns PNG bytes, ?auth=token variant works, has_lampiran + employee_tipe present on GET /leaves; after admin verify, pegawai upload → 400 as required, admin upload still allowed; (d) invalid extension (.exe) rejected 400; (e) official PDF: content-type application/pdf, %PDF- header, size > 1.5KB. Frontend Playwright: Pengaturan → Pengguna → 'Tambah Pengguna' modal shows u-tipe dropdown with options ['Pegawai ASN','Tenaga BLUD'] (checkbox BLUD replaced), u-role-admin/etc checkboxes still present; created TEST ASN user, toast 'Pengguna ditambahkan', table row shows ASN badge (indigo). Table shows correct badge distribution: 7 BLUD (teal) + 3 ASN (indigo) among pegawai1..10, matching pegawai3/pegawai6/pegawai9 = ASN. /cuti as pegawai1: 'Ajukan Cuti' opens dialog with cuti-form-saldo block displaying Bersama=3, N-2=3, N-1=6, N=12 plus priority hint; cuti-submit button present. Existing leave (status Dibatalkan) shows cuti-print + cuti-lampiran icons; cuti-upload correctly hidden (only appears when status=Diajukan) — behavior verified via backend test.

issues: Console hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> — visual-editing wrapper injects span inside <option>. Non-blocking dev-mode warning but noisy in console.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~1916 lines — still well past the 700-line guideline. Recommend router split before adding more features (routers/users, routers/leaves, routers/sip, routers/spm).

POST /leaves/{id}/attachment returns {'ok': true, 'lampiran_filename': ...} instead of the updated leave object — inconsistent with other endpoints; UI has to refetch. Consider returning the updated leave.

Attachment upload allows admin to upload even after verify (correct), but there is no size/mime validation error message differentiation between MAX_FILE_SIZE and ALLOWED_EXT — both return 400 with different Indonesian messages (ok, but no error code).
test_credentials: admin/admin123, pegawai1/pegawai123, kepala/kepala123 — all working (login body key 'identifier').
